scope: Full codebase — 2 specialists (quality-oracle, dependency-auditor); performance-profiler and chaos-monkey skipped (services offline)

escalations.title: Handlebars.js Remote Code Execution — Source/Backend
escalations.detail: Any backend template compiled from attacker-controlled input executes arbitrary code. JavaScript injection via AST Type Confusion.

escalations.title: protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution — platform/orchestrator
escalations.detail: Prototype pollution allows arbitrary code generation attacks on protobuf/JSON inputs. Orchestrator likely processes untrusted external messages.
escalations.trigger: injection — RCE via protobuf message parsing

p1_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Scope Gap — 96 requirements invisible to gate
p1_findings.detail: Enforcer covers only 13 of 109 requirements (12%). Reports PASSED while Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md (86 reqs) and Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md (10 reqs) are never evaluated. Green CI gate is a false confidence signal.
p1_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to accept --specs-dir Specifications/ flag and add portal/ + platform/ to scan dirs.
p1_findings.cross_ref: Root cause for QO-002 going undetected

p1_findings.title: Ghost Requirements — FR-070..095 and FR-DUP-* referenced but never specified
p1_findings.detail: 50+ Verifies comments cite FR-070..095 and FR-DUP-01..FR-DUP-13. None of these IDs exist in any Specifications/ file. Inverted traceability — code claims to verify unwritten requirements.
p1_findings.recommendation: (a) Write specs for FR-070..095 and FR-DUP-* in Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md; (b) update code comments to canonical IDs. Option (a) is correct per spec-first mandate.
p1_findings.cross_ref: Detected because QO-001 was found; fixing QO-001 enables automated detection

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-metrics: dependencyCheckDuration Histogram missing
p2_findings.detail: Spec requires 4 metrics; only 3 implemented. dependencyCheckDuration Histogram completely absent.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add Histogram 'dependency_check_duration_seconds' to metrics.ts; instrument in dependency.ts; add test.
p2_findings.cross_ref: Part of FR-dependency-* incomplete implementation cluster (QO-003, QO-004, QO-005)

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed: Seed data completely unimplemented
p2_findings.detail: No seed script or data fixture exists for required dependency relationships (BUG-0010 blocked_by BUG-0003..0007; FR-0004 blocked_by FR-0003, etc.).
p2_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/store/seed.ts with idempotent startup seeding; guard with existence checks.
p2_findings.cross_ref: Part of FR-dependency-* incomplete implementation cluster

p2_findings.title: pending_dependencies not in WorkItemStatus enum despite documented usage
p2_findings.detail: api-contracts.md documents pending_dependencies as required dispatch-gating status. Enum has no PendingDependencies value; VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS has no entry. Shared-type change affects backend + frontend.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add PendingDependencies = 'pending_dependencies'; add transitions; coordinate backend + frontend layers.
p2_findings.cross_ref: Part of FR-dependency-* incomplete implementation cluster

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS — platform/orchestrator
p2_findings.detail: Malicious URLs cause catastrophic regex backtracking, making orchestrator routing unresponsive.
p2_findings.recommendation: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update path-to-regexp (auto-fixed with protobufjs update).
p2_findings.cross_ref: CROSS-REF: DEP-002 — same npm update in platform/orchestrator resolves both
